title: 第1章 简单任务(一)
content_zh:
“唐峰，许强，关智勇.你们三人出列。”Z国某山区内一支神秘的部队所在地，此刻战士们正在进行下午的训练，而他们的头，也就是这支部队的最高长官一位身着少将军衔的中年军人站在操场的边缘喊道。

“是。”三声洪亮的声音在这空旷的操场上响起。随着声落，只见队伍最前面的三个年轻人动作如一的向前迈进一步。

中年人悄声叹了口气道：“回去解除武装来我办公室。”说罢转身走向不远处的办公楼。

而三个年轻人相互对望一眼疑惑的朝宿舍走去。

10分钟后，三人洗好了澡穿好了衣服。

“峰哥，你说首长叫咱们干啥？咱啥错误也没犯啊。”说话的这人叫许强，是三人中年龄最小的一个，在过2个月刚好22岁，虽然年龄小可身体确是不含糊，1.90米的身高，110公斤的体重，在三人中绝对是个庞然大物。

“小强，别想那么多，首长叫咱们肯定是有任务给咱们。”关智勇说道。这个关智勇真还挺对得起他的名字，手上工夫没得说，在整个基地里除了唐峰，许强等少数人外还真没什么敌手，而智商方面更是不含糊，至少基地里没人不佩服的。

最辉煌的战绩就是曾经把他们上一任的教官给整了，就在谁都以为这丫要倒霉的时候结果却令众人大跌眼睛，这丫不但没事，相反还因此和上一任教官成了好朋友，可惜上一任教官在一次执行任务的时候为了救一个战友而光荣了。

唐峰听完两人的话后并没有开口，只是深深的看了两人一眼，率先走了出去。

许强见唐峰没说话，急忙上前和唐峰并排走，嘴里还嘟嘟囔囔的说道：“真是奇了怪了，按理说要是有任务要咱执行没必要要首长亲自前来啊，平时都是队长下达任务的。难道这任务很艰巨？那也不对啊，要是真这么严重就不该只叫咱们三个啊。”

嘟囔完后许强扣了扣头便不在去想，他这个人最大的好处就是想不通的就不继续想，按他的话说就是：“咱是笨人，没必要为了想一个自己死也想不通的事而谋杀大量的脑细胞，反正有峰哥和勇哥在，咱不怕吃亏，他们也不会让咱吃亏。”

许强的话引起了唐峰和关智勇的注意，两人皱了皱眉头思考着什么。

基地挺大，不过却只有3栋楼而已，一栋是战士的宿舍楼，一栋是干部的办公兼宿舍楼，还有一栋就是食堂了。其他地方都是训练场所，不论什么训练项目在这里似乎都能找得见。

抬头看了看天上的烈日，唐峰轻轻叹了口气想道：“我怎么有种不好的预感呢？”当然他这话并没有说出来，因为他知道如果他这么说了那剩下两人都会胡思乱想的，因为他可是基地里出了名的“神算”。

或许是特异功能吧，他总是能在危险来临之前有些感应，正是这种本能才能使他在大大小小不下50次的任务中安全存活下来，因此他也成为了基地里最受欢迎的人，谁不想执行任务的时候能有个活“雷达”在身边啊？何况他比雷达还厉害，雷达至少还有盲区呢。

“报告。”三人站在首长办公室外整了整衣服，齐声喊道。

“进来。”首长那熟悉的声音从里面传了出来。

推开门后，三人走了进去，而首长却站在办公桌旁，原本因该属于首长的座椅上此时赫然坐着一位身披上将军衔的老者。

“蓝鹰部队第一大队第三小队小队长唐峰（队员许强）（队员关智勇）前来报道，请首长指示。”三人只是稍稍差异一下便恢复了常态，这就是一个优秀军人的素质。

老将军点点头说：“你们知道我是谁吗？”

“那你们想知道我叫你们来是为什么吗？”老将军又问道。

“该知道的首长一定会告诉我们，不该知道的我们也不想知道。”

说罢拿起桌上的一份文件念道：“唐峰，SX省XA市人1983年11月11日出生。

2000年7月入伍，随后被分配到XJ省，在与东突份子的战斗中多次立功，其中一等功1次二等功3次三等功3次，先后5次重伤差点死亡。

2003年被选入蓝鹰部队，因为每次任务中杀敌最多，被战友们送了个外号叫“死神”。

在蓝鹰部队4年时间先后执行57次任务，每次都成功，而与你同组的战友很少出现伤亡，因为你有种未卜先知的能力，因此战友们又送你一个外号叫“神算”。

2004年3月在秘密前往M国抓补重犯的过程中因表现异常优秀被授予少校军衔，2005年6月前往阿富汗执行任务后被授予中校军衔，同时顶替战死的刘刚成为第一大队第三小队队长。

特点：表面和气容易被人接受，头脑冷静，极重义气，下手狠，天生的领导者。

擅长：枪类武器，搏击，制定作战计划，有一定的危险预知能力。

父亲唐正国是一个做电子生意的商人。

说完后老将军抬头看了看唐峰，见他毫无表情的目视前方，仿佛自己所说的和他一点关系都没有一般。

满意的点点头后老将军继续道：“许强，HLJ省DQ市人。

1985年10月7日出生，2002年入伍，被分配到HLJ某师当兵。

2004年在全国部队比武大赛上获得第一名（注名：这种比赛不允许特种军人参加，否则以许强当时的能力不可能获得第一名。），随后被蓝鹰部队录取。

在蓝鹰部队先后3年间执行任务36次，其中因战友疏忽失败5次。

先后立过一等功1次，三等功2次，因体型关系战友送外号“坦克”。目前是少校军衔。

特点：对自己人脾气好，对外人容易冲动，重义气。

父亲许安，HLJ省DQ油田一名普通工人，在1996年一次油井事故中丧身。

母亲刘玫开了一家小商店将你养大，三年前因病去世。”

听望老将军的话后许强虽然依旧面无表情，但任谁都能看得出他眼中的热泪。

“关智勇，SD省JN人，1983年12月25日出生。

2002年6月毕业与国防科技大学，同年9月做为技术型人材被蓝鹰部队录取。

录取后却对格斗产生浓烈兴趣，随后3年每年都会向领导提出调到作战部队的要求，3年后被调到作战部队。

2年时间执行任务22次，无一失败，先后立过二等功3次，三等功2次。

因头脑好用每次任务都能想出些奇着而被战友们称为“智囊”，目前是中校军衔。

特点：头脑聪明且冷静，及好面子，重义气。

父亲关民，SD大学物理系教授，国家二等津贴受用者，中科院物理研究院副主任。

“我说的有错吗？”老将军抬起头看着三人道。

“那么你们考虑好接受我的任务了吗？”老将军又问道。

“只要国家需要，我们保证完成任务。”

“先别答应的这么爽快，我问你们，如果我是要你们离开部队，听清楚了，不是暂时的离开，而是永远离开，你们还会愿意吗？”老将军面色严肃的问。

一听这话，三人顿时哑了，他们还真没想过自己会离开部队，蓝鹰部队人本来就少，整个基地也只有500人左右，其中还有200人是技术型人材和后勤部，真正战斗人员只有300人，被分成3个大队，每个大队又被分成4个小队，可以说经过几年的相处这区区300人的关系都如亲兄弟般，毕竟他们的友谊是经过铁与血的考验啊。要让他们离开他们还真不舍得。

老将军看着三人的样子，站起身双手背后严肃的道：“你们是什么？”

“Z国最强野战特种大队蓝鹰的战士。”

“那么好，眼前就有一个机会给你们，你们是去还是不去？当然，如果你们怕死的话可以选择不去。”

“不，我们是蓝鹰的兵，是祖国的守护者，我们不怕死，只要是为祖国，为人民，我们坚决完成首长分配给我们的每一项任务，哪怕是付出生命的代价。”

“很好，你们要记住，正如你们所说的，你们是祖国的守护者，为了国家的繁荣昌盛个人荣辱不值得一提，你们去收拾东西吧，半个小时后来这里报道。”

“是。”说罢三人转身走了出去，只是其中以有两人差点流下了热泪。
content_en:
"Tang Feng, Xu Qiang, Guan Zhiyong. The three of you come out." A mysterious army is located in a mountainous area of ​​Country Z. At this moment, the soldiers are undergoing afternoon training, and their head, the highest officer of the army, a middle-aged soldier with the rank of major general, stood on the edge of the playground and shouted.

"Yes." Three loud voices sounded in the empty playground.As the sound fell, the three young people at the front of the team took a step forward in unison.

The middle-aged man sighed quietly and said, "Go back and disarm and come to my office." After that, he turned and walked towards the office building not far away.

The three young people looked at each other in confusion and walked toward the dormitory.

Ten minutes later, the three of them took a shower and got dressed.

"Brother Feng, what do you think the chief asked us to do? We haven't made any mistakes." The person who spoke was called Xu Qiang. He was the youngest of the three. He turned 22 in two months. Although he was young, his body was unambiguous. He was 1.90 meters tall and weighed 110 kilograms. He was definitely a giant among the three.

"Xiaoqiang, don't think so much. The chief told us that he must have a task for us." Guan Zhiyong said.This Guan Zhiyong is really worthy of his name. There is nothing to say about his skill. Apart from Tang Feng, Xu Qiang and a few others, there are really no opponents in the entire base. And his IQ is even more unambiguous. At least no one in the base does not admire him.

The most glorious achievement was that they once punished their previous instructor. Just when everyone thought that this girl was going to be unlucky, the result surprised everyone. Not only was this girl fine, but she also became good friends with the previous instructor because of it. Unfortunately, the previous instructor was honored for saving a comrade during a mission.

Tang Feng didn't speak after hearing what the two said. He just looked at the two deeply and walked out first.

Seeing that Tang Feng didn't speak, Xu Qiang hurried forward and walked side by side with Tang Feng, mumbling: "It's really strange. Logically speaking, if there is a task for us to carry out, there is no need for the leader to come in person. The captain usually issues the task. Is this task very difficult? That's not right. If it is really so serious, we shouldn't just call the three of us."

After mumbling, Xu Qiang buckled down and stopped thinking. The biggest advantage of him is that he doesn't continue to think about things that he can't figure out. According to his words: "We are stupid people. There is no need to kill a lot of brain cells just to think about something that we can't figure out even after death. Anyway, with Brother Feng and Brother Yong here, we are not afraid of suffering, and they will not let us suffer."

Xu Qiang's words attracted the attention of Tang Feng and Guan Zhiyong, who frowned and thought about something.

The base is quite large, but it only has three buildings. One is the dormitory building for soldiers, one is the office and dormitory building for cadres, and the other is the canteen.The rest of the place is a training ground, and no matter what kind of training program it seems, you can find it here.

Looking up at the scorching sun in the sky, Tang Feng sighed softly and thought, "Why do I have a bad premonition?" Of course, he didn't say this out loud, because he knew that if he did, the other two would have crazy thoughts, because he was a famous "divine figure" in the base.

Maybe it's a special ability. He can always sense danger before it approaches. It is this instinct that allows him to survive no less than 50 missions, large and small. Therefore, he has become the most popular person in the base. Who doesn't want to have a living "radar" by his side when performing missions?What's more, he is more powerful than radar, which at least has a blind spot.

"Report." The three of them stood outside the chief's office, straightened their clothes, and shouted in unison.

"Come in." The familiar voice of the chief came from inside.

After opening the door, the three of them walked in, but the chief stood beside the desk. An old man with the rank of general sat on the chair that should have belonged to the chief.

"Tang Feng (player Xu Qiang) (player Guan Zhiyong), captain of the third team of the First Battalion of the Blue Eagle Force, came to report and asked for instructions from the leader." The three of them returned to normal with only a slight difference. This is the quality of an excellent soldier.

The old general nodded and said, "Do you know who I am?"

"Then you want to know why I called you here?" the old general asked again.

"The chief will tell us what we should know, and we don't want to know what we shouldn't know."

After that, he picked up a document on the table and read: "Tang Feng, born on November 11, 1983, in XA City, SX Province.

He joined the army in July 2000 and was subsequently assigned to XJ Province. He made many meritorious service in the battle with the East Turkestan elements, including first-class merit once, second-class merit three times and third-class merit three times. He was seriously injured five times and almost died.

In 2003, he was selected into the Blue Eagle Force. Because he killed the most enemies in each mission, he was nicknamed "The God of Death" by his comrades.

In the Blue Eagle Force, you have carried out 57 missions in 4 years, each time with success, and your comrades in the same group rarely suffered casualties. Because you have the ability to predict the unpredictable, your comrades gave you the nickname "Divine Calculation".

In March 2004, he was awarded the rank of major due to his outstanding performance while secretly going to country M to arrest felons. In June 2005, he was awarded the rank of lieutenant colonel after performing a mission in Afghanistan. At the same time, he replaced Liu Gang, who died in battle, and became the captain of the third team of the first battalion.

Characteristics: Friendly on the surface, easily accepted by others, calm-minded, extremely loyal, ruthless, and a natural leader.

Good at: gun weapons, fighting, formulating combat plans, and has a certain ability to predict danger.

His father, Tang Zhengguo, is a businessman in the electronics business.

After finishing speaking, the old general looked up at Tang Feng and saw that he was looking straight ahead with no expression, as if what he said had nothing to do with him.

After nodding with satisfaction, the old general continued: "Xu Qiang is from DQ City, HLJ Province.

Born on October 7, 1985, he joined the army in 2002 and was assigned to serve as a soldier in a certain division of HLJ.

In 2004, he won first place in the National Army Competition (Note: Special forces are not allowed to participate in this kind of competition, otherwise it would be impossible for Xu Qiang to win first place with his ability at the time.), and was subsequently admitted to the Blue Eagle Army.

In the Blue Eagle Force, he performed 36 missions in 3 years, including 5 failures due to the negligence of his comrades.

He has achieved first-class merit once and third-class merit twice. Due to his size, he was nicknamed "Tank" by his comrades.Currently holds the rank of Major.

Characteristics: Good-tempered towards others, easily impulsive towards outsiders, and values ​​loyalty.

Father Xu An, an ordinary worker in the DQ oil field of HLJ Province, died in an oil well accident in 1996.

Your mother, Liu Mei, opened a small shop and raised you. She died of illness three years ago."

Although Xu Qiang remained expressionless after listening to the old general's words, anyone could see the tears in his eyes.

"Guan Zhiyong, a native of JN, SD Province, was born on December 25, 1983.

He graduated from the National University of Defense Technology in June 2002 and was admitted to the Blue Eagle Army as a technical talent in September of the same year.

After being admitted, he developed a strong interest in fighting. For the next three years, he asked his leaders to be transferred to the combat unit every year. After three years, he was transferred to the combat unit.

In 2 years, he performed 22 missions without any failure. He achieved second-class merit 3 times and third-class merit 2 times.

He is called a "brain tank" by his comrades because of his good brain and can come up with some unique ideas for every mission. He currently holds the rank of lieutenant colonel.

Characteristics: Smart and calm, good face, and loyal.

His father, Guan Min, is a professor in the Department of Physics of SD University, recipient of the second-class national subsidy, and deputy director of the Institute of Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

"Am I wrong?" the old general raised his head and looked at the three of them.

"So have you considered accepting my mission?" the old general asked again.

"As long as the country needs it, we promise to complete the mission."

"Don't agree so readily. Let me ask you, if I asked you to leave the army, please understand, not temporarily, but forever, would you still be willing?" the old general asked with a serious face.

Upon hearing this, the three of them were speechless. They had never thought that they would leave the army. There were only a few people in the Blue Eagle army, and there were only about 500 people in the entire base, of which 200 were technical personnel and logistics personnel. There were only 300 actual combatants, who were divided into 3 brigades, and each brigades were divided into 4 squads. It can be said that after several years of getting along, the relationship between these 300 people is like brothers. After all, their friendship has been tested by iron and blood.They were really reluctant to let them go.

The old general looked at the three of them, stood up and said seriously with his hands behind his back: "Who are you?"

"A soldier of the Blue Eagle, the strongest field special forces brigade in country Z."

"Okay then, there is an opportunity for you. Do you want to go or not? Of course, if you are afraid of death, you can choose not to go."

"No, we are soldiers of the Blue Eagle and the guardians of the motherland. We are not afraid of death. As long as it is for the motherland and the people, we will resolutely complete every task assigned to us by the leader, even at the cost of our lives."

"Very good. You have to remember that, as you said, you are the guardians of the motherland. For the prosperity of the country, personal honor and disgrace are not worth mentioning. You go pack your things and report here in half an hour."

"Yes." After saying that, the three of them turned and walked out, but two of them almost shed tears.
